extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed a Humana Part D plan with the customer, provided a disclaimer, and collected a Scope of Appointment. The call was compliant with the rules.
composition.coaching_note: Grace did well by delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment promptly. However, Grace could have scheduled the appointment closer to the time of the call to ensure the customer has the most recent information.
